schema.description: Request body for the BFL Flux Tools Video Edit v1 API. Charges are based on the delivered output duration; the output length, resolution, aspect ratio and audio come from the source clip.

prompt.description: Edit instruction. Names the objects, setting, style, on-screen text or dialogue to change; everything not named is preserved.

safety_tolerance.description: Tolerance level for input and output moderation, 0 being most strict.

video.description: Video to edit, either an HTTP(S) URL or a base64-encoded MP4. At most 15 seconds of source footage and 50 MiB, with each side at least 160 pixels; sources above 720p are downscaled to 720p.
